historic_text: The Word Spell · 3 Breath · Main. Exhaust one ready visible enemy Person or Speaker. Alternatively endorse the Writ by exhausting your mature ready Signet as an additional cost; then choose up to two distinct ready visible enemy Things of any kind, at least one. Endorsement is paid at declaration and spends one Signet action. Removing Signet afterwards does not erase a stamped order. Revalidate the chosen recipients independently. Ward applies normally when exactly one hostile Thing is targeted. Doubt can counter the Spell at its printed cost 3. Exhaustion makes defenders unavailable for blocks during this turn; it never removes their printed abilities. Between Writ and the eventual attack, other Clauses and responses can still matter.
rationale: The basic order opens a lane. The seal can swing the fight but cannot also ward a piece.
